body: Ye brought out Future at Night 1 in Chicago and he performed “F*** Up Some Commas” in front of over 70,000 Fans 🤯🔥 Future dropped “F*** Up Some Commas” on Monster in 2014, then ran it as the lead single from DS2 in 2015. DJ Spinz and Southside on the beat. It peaked at #55 on the Hot 100 and #14 on R&B/Hip-Hop. First Future single to even chart on the Hot 100. Spent 20 weeks there. Now it’s 5x Platinum in the U.S., 2x Platinum in Canada, Silver in the UK. Over 376 million Spotify streams. The song didn’t blow immediately. It sat on the tape, then became the siren record. Club, radio, every party after that. Still one of the hardest DS2 records he ever put out.

source_caption_text:
Ye brought out Future at Night 1 in Chicago and he performed “F*** Up Some Commas” in front of over 70,000 Fans 🤯🔥

Future dropped “F*** Up Some Commas” on Monster in 2014, then ran it as the lead single from DS2 in 2015. DJ Spinz and Southside on the beat.

It peaked at #55 on the Hot 100 and #14 on R&B/Hip-Hop. First Future single to even chart on the Hot 100. Spent 20 weeks there. Now it’s 5x Platinum in the U.S., 2x Platinum in Canada, Silver in the UK. Over 376 million Spotify streams.

The song didn’t blow immediately. It sat on the tape, then became the siren record. Club, radio, every party after that. Still one of the hardest DS2 records he ever put out.
